Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: Current main contains decoder/admission repairs, native trial ML/public readout, the comparison harness and exact Cascade34 realization. Local law suites pass; weak LWU admission still misses its 95% scientific target. The old ready-stage table and private-job handoffs are historical. Complete decoded B0, original-family trial certification, scientific calibration, repeated performance and release remain unresolved.

Fresh context: Yes: partial engineering; qualification pending.

Next action: Resume through current PHRF-11/21/29 acceptance gaps, then PHRF-33's complete-workload decision and PHRF-14/15/16. S10 pilot wiring/custody rehearsal is a distinct harness gap. Keep optional finite-state work deferred until the measured activation decision.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-pilot-integration-20261004.md; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md; docs/verification/profile-ml-public-output-2026-09-30.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

# PHRF remediation roadmap — 2026-09-13

Authoritative tracker: epic bd-01M24MQABKEBQXW89VZ8XWBB8H. This roadmap records user-authorized planning after the quality review of e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba. It is not an implementation or passing qualification receipt.

Disposition:
- Reopen PHRF-09 (decoder correctness), PHRF-12 (certified condition preparation) and PHRF-21 (condition requalification).
- Keep PHRF-07 closed for the implemented banded/Schur backend and PHRF-18 closed for the standalone mathematical certificate.
- Add required PHRF-32 (trial laws) and PHRF-33 (complete B0 checkpoint). Old B0 timings remain component measurements. PHRF-10 is deferred provisionally until the complete checkpoint decision.
- There are now 28 required tickets: 18 retain closed status and 10 require completion. Five other children remain optional/deferred.

| Stage | Tickets and direct readiness | Concrete delivery / exit evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1A, start first | PHRF-09 bd-01M24MSAQZ2MF2KGQEG1K33E6C; ready | Repair terminal curvature/SD/admission, exhausted-budget statuses, prior-consistent ranking and invalid-node handling. Promote all four exact review reproductions to shared regressions; count terminal verification; JVM+JS tests and warning-clean compile. |
| 1B, independent preparation work | PHRF-12 bd-01M24MSQS8HFQBPY2TAVW1FJGM; ready | Bind actual family/basis/drive/run/mask/nuisance/whitening identities to validated observed-family admission at both condition entry points. Reject inadequate/mismatched geometry before response reads; end-to-end refusal and good-geometry laws. Coordinate existing design-identity work. |
| 1C, independent numerical work | PHRF-32 bd-01M2DF9F9D49JMWGJ2N4YT2K88; ready | Preserve two-run geometry under full trial-record permutation and compare inverse-permuted amplitudes, jets and determinant to original results. Add 3D Cascade34 dense/finite-difference parity including rho=0; JVM+JS evidence. |
| 2A, condition milestone | PHRF-21 bd-01M25Q0JY8GA7CJRKZF2934PJ0; waits for 09/12 plus existing shared prerequisites | Requalify frozen Gaussian/LWU cohorts using returned-point curvature and enforced geometry admission. Retain unchanged accuracy/admission gates and LWU SNR 0.5's historical 83% shortfall. Measure complete supported condition paths and publish restricted/unmet scopes honestly. Independent of trial/B0. |
| 2B, trial integration | PHRF-29 bd-01M26A285YAQ3H8TGS26BK9T7J; waits for 09/12/32 and existing 07 | Typed sibling plan and actual shared decoder attached to TrialBanded, shared immutable bank/worker-local scratch, bounded sink/executor and cancellation, identity/provenance and off-node shape integration tests. Do not claim a discarded-jet benchmark is integration. |
| 3, public trial readout | PHRF-11 bd-01M24MSJQZH70BTAFYTXD3MPZZ; waits for 29 and existing 22 | Read at returned theta; signed normalized trial/condition/query output, nuisance recovery, constrained ML determinant/derivative contract or explicit refusal, original-equation/basis/readout certification, bounded correction and explicit exact option. Preserve adaptive-vs-frozen-linear distinction. |
| 4, early engineering decision | PHRF-33 bd-01M2DFAXBST1R9P4GJ29MKT6GM; waits for 11/21/32 | Actual complete B0 profile+readout+certification on frozen T=600,N=300,V=100000 geometry plus declared N=1200 stress/schedule cells. All attempted work/phases/factors/solves/memory accounted; oracle-checked outputs; <=120s/<=256MiB and <=12x/<=24x ratio receipts or explicit failures. Settle finite-state decision here. |
| 5, scientific qualification | PHRF-14 bd-01M24MSZ4Z6BFWRV5R4S67VDN0; waits for 33 plus existing 04/11/21 | Separate numerical, search, scientific recovery/coverage and resource claims. Freeze confirmation regimes; >=500 replicates per claimed interval regime with binomial uncertainty; null/misspecified/weak/prior/pooling cases; no accepted-only hidden denominators. |
| 6, repeated performance | PHRF-15 bd-01M24MT58X8W2Z0KJ25JJG2SGP; waits for 14/33/11 | >=5 measured runs with median/p95, raw receipts, equivalent complete work, C0/B0 absolute and ratio targets, JVM/JS/scaling/bandwidth evidence. Execute PHRF benchmarks in scheduled/manual workflow; retain unmet cells. |
| 7, release | PHRF-16 bd-01M24MTB363KSHN1KDRSAM2KNH; waits for 14/15/21 | Inspect all evidence and exact revisions, full required JVM+JS bounded gates, runnable consumer and actual exported axis/units, current non-draft work map and explicit admitted scope. Publication remains separately authorized. |

Dependency changes:
- 21 additionally depends on 09.
- 29 additionally depends on 09 and 32.
- 32 depends on completed 07 and 04.
- 33 depends on 11, 21 and 32.
- 14 and 15 additionally depend on 33.
- Deferred 10 additionally depends on 33; existing 30 prerequisite remains.
- Existing blocking and containment edges are preserved.

PHRF-33 must close with the measured decision, not with fabricated green targets. A passing complete checkpoint keeps PHRF-10 deferred. A budget miss must carry a concrete engineering/activation disposition; if it activates finite-state work, promote PHRF-10 and its required PHRF-30 realization and wire them into qualification/release before declaring eligibility. The checkpoint does not depend on PHRF-14 or PHRF-15, avoiding a cycle and preserving the early decision.

Every updated ticket body contains implementation paths, exact failure examples where available, expected behavior, meaningful numerical/lifecycle checks, platform gates and closure boundaries. The PHRF-09 evidence note contains the full review probe source so future work does not depend on temporary files. Planning does not authorize source fixes, new scientific claims or a Git push.


---
Historical epic description (the dated remediation roadmap above governs current status and checkpoint interpretation):

Current adopted scope

Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P1 active PHRF epic. The live graph correctly closes through PHRF-16 and keeps required provider/trial/readout/calibration/performance tasks at P1. The original body predates adopted v2: its blanket required PHRF-01..22, mandatory exact seven-state loop and universal finite-state performance wording do not override v2. Required release is CompactCondition plus TrialBanded; PHRF-10 is activated only by the PHRF-07 B0 checkpoint, while PHRF-23/24/30/31 remain optional. Already closed condition/shared-contract children are credited, not reopened by the old sentence that all implementation children remain open. Current trial outputs remain refused on the condition path, so the unified epic cannot close on condition-only evidence. Preserve scientific normalization/identity/rank, resource, independent oracle and admission constraints; apply finite-state-specific acceptance only if that backend is admitted. Canonical current work-item map is docs/plans/profile-hrf-work-items-v2.md, with PHRF-29 as the required sibling-plan/executor integration. This is a scope correction to match adopted v2, not a new deferral decision or implementation claim.

Scientific and performance contract (finite-state clauses conditional as above)

Deliver one ProfileHrf engine with ConditionMeans (exact alpha=0,u=0) and ConditionCenteredTrials (finite positive alpha=1/lambda), one constrained shape per voxel shared across selected conditions/trials, signed local amplitudes, and compiled response queries. Share scientific family/drive contracts, profile criterion/derivatives, bounded decoder, pooling policy, diagnostics and streaming execution. Preserve specialized CompactCondition and TrialBanded loops; exact seven-state Cascade34 realization remains optional under v2. No new top-level module or competing condition/trial engine.

Ownership: hrf defines parametric scalar families, constraints, normalization, derivative/realization recipes; design retains complete unconvolved drives and structural amplitude/shape-sharing identities with direct condition aggregation; model defines a sibling ProfileHrfPlan with typed amplitude/criterion/output/budget policies; fit/profile owns observed compilation, backend-specific encodings/workspaces and shared inference/execution; Gale owns generic QR/SVD/rank/banded factors. Existing fixed FitPlan/DesignSchema and LSS TrialReadout contracts remain valid.

Implementation order: PHRF-01 freezes unified scientific/performance contracts; PHRF-17 repairs current coefficient-penalty transport and PHRF-20 installs early measurement/work-counting. PHRF-02/03/05/08 establish shared families/drives/energy jets. PHRF-18/19 add compact conditions using the common PHRF-09 decoder; PHRF-12/13/22 provide one bounded executor, frozen pilot and signed query contract. PHRF-21 qualifies a usable condition-only milestone WITHOUT waiting for Gale banded factors or trial/state completion. PHRF-06/07 and PHRF-04/10 then/alongside supply trial backends; PHRF-11 adds trial readouts/queries through the common contracts. PHRF-14/15/16 qualify full release. Numeric ticket order is not dependency order.

Required scope follows docs/plans/profile-hrf-work-items-v2.md and the PHRF-16 release graph, including PHRF-29. PHRF-10 is conditional on the PHRF-07 B0 checkpoint; PHRF-30/31 are optional. PHRF-23 (frozen readout field/MVPA) and PHRF-24 (bounded stimulus features) are optional post-v1 children and must not block required completion. Closing PHRF-21 proves condition-only scope, not the entire epic. Each unfinished implementation child closes only when its own evidence exists; completed children retain their recorded scope.

Scientific acceptance:
1. Exact alpha=0 is lowered to aggregated condition drives and a compact observed family; no huge lambda, trial-sized design/factor/workspace or trial covariance preparation. K is admitted by projector/derivative/conditioning accuracy, never assumed equal to shape dimension. Budget failure refuses instead of silently truncating.
2. Common energy E=s-b'G^-1 b and its full gradient/Hessian include shape-dependent s in temporal filtering. Ridge-and-release, free-mean rank policy, full constrained-trial ML determinant and normalization derivatives agree with independent dense/augmented-QR oracles. Penalized energy, residual energy, local observed curvature and sampling/posterior uncertainty are distinct.
3. One smooth normalization and amplitude-penalty contract per family. Equivalent scale changes transform lambda/alpha (and Gamma for optional features); coefficient penalties use inverse congruence while covariance uses forward congruence. Fix the current BasisTransform diagonal penalty defect with invariant-objective regressions before admission.
4. Gaussian/LWU remain their named scalar families; explicit half-cosine smooth charts/cells, no generic six-parameter decoder. Cascade34 remains g3(t,kp)-rho*g4(t,ku), kp>ku>0,rho>=0, positive-component-unit-area, exact common trial impulse across branches. Boxes/multiphase random forcing and observation averaging require separate state admission. Censor gaps propagate HRF state and event inputs.
5. One bounded router/decoder and separate identification/approximation/preparation receipts. Effective response under the declared drive is not automatically vascular identification. Signed queries retain units, coverage, split provenance and uncertainty availability; adaptive readout is not response-independent LSS or its total derivative. Held-out target labels cannot define shrinkage coding for supervised prediction.
6. Default bounded pilot <=2048 voxels and <=2 preparation passes; freeze prior/scales/routing then stream full blocks. No required K*V score matrix, K*K outer products over all voxels, whole-brain covariance or collected amplitude blocks. Optional compact spool, full-cohort pooling, query/operator reuse and feature ranks have explicit budgets.
7. Required JVM+JS numerical/scientific/performance gates and real consumer/export checks pass on exact provider/source revisions. Run compileAll and complete test coverage in bounded module batches per AGENTS.md. No inferred passing result from local Python probes or pending/unrelated gates.

Preserved engineering mandate: no nonlinear optimizer, line search, per-voxel large factorization/covariance preparation or unbounded fallback. At most eight prepared references per geometry and two evaluated references per voxel; every center/stencil/routing/finalist evaluation and certification cost is counted. Runtime condition stencils are compiled to jets; the 60-center demonstration does not satisfy the production budget. Keep one trial amplitude correction and at most one additional certification inverse application.

Condition baseline C0: T=600,C=3,six fixed columns,V=100000,d<=3, same condition-aggregated 300-event schedule as B0; admitted K<=96,C<=8 capacity. Proposed <=30-second complete CPU compute goal on the same declared JVM host and <=256 MiB engine memory, including compilation/banks/worker buffers. Post-projection routing/decoding/readout target <= initial compact projection time. Measure K=32/64/96 only where accuracy admits, T=600/1000,C=3/8 and V=10000/20000/100000. Use the same attempted-cohort shape/amplitude accuracy gates as B0, scoped to condition outputs; near-zero amplitudes use preregistered absolute scale. Report cold compilation, pilot, IO and process RSS separately and in complete totals. Compare the K-column projection and canonical fixed-shape condition fit as different baselines. This adds a target; it does not weaken the existing trial goals.

Existing work to reuse: transactional sink/catalog bd-01KX6G9B8R86MRBZ9S8K8F5G7V; uncertainty provenance bd-01M210WJ4BWVCXEMTARHDR2AC7; known-truth calibration bd-01M21VA8DYMNJS9PZ8076SBWWJ. PHRF-06 is a consumer admission gate for upstream Gale banded capabilities, not a condition milestone prerequisite.

Performance goals and benchmark contract (targets, not achieved results):
- B0 representative case: T=600 observations, N=300 trials, C=3 conditions, 6 full-rank fixed regressors, V=100,000 voxels, d=3, r=7 for Cascade34; Float64 computation and Float32 trial output (120 MB decimal). Stream generated/input responses and outputs. Freeze sparse and dense event schedules, lambda, noise transform, family domains, reference cells and seeds before optimization. Also run N=1,200 and V=10,000/20,000/100,000 scaling cases.
- Hard bounded-execution contract: bank <=8 prepared references per geometry; <=2 references evaluated per voxel; one second-order amplitude residual correction; at most one additional reference solve for residual certification. Count all score/readout/certification work. No per-voxel N-by-N or T-by-T factorization, no per-voxel covariance-gain preparation, no unbounded nonlinear fallback. State scoring has no trial-sized derivative solves. One shared observation geometry in v1; unsupported geometry fails explicitly.
- Engine live-memory goal <=256 MiB for B0, including prepared reference bank and all active worker buffers, with block size <=256 voxels per worker and <=8 workers. Exclude VM/runtime baseline and files on disk, not buffers or retained result payloads. Report whole-process peak RSS separately. Increasing V from 10,000 to 100,000 at fixed concurrency/block size should add <=max(32 MiB,10% of baseline engine live memory). No N*d*V derivative field, no retained V-sized collection of amplitude blocks; small scalar receipts are allowed.
- Steady-state compute scaling goal: doubling V from 10,000 to 20,000 costs <=2.3x at fixed geometry, threads and backend, with IO reported separately. Finite-state score-only time at fixed T,C,F,d,r and reference count should change <=20% when N grows 300->1,200 after preparation; report event preparation and terminal O(N) readout separately.
- Relative runtime goals: complete one-reference profile+readout <=12x the same backend's exact fixed-shape fit+trial readout; two-reference <=24x. On the frozen dense-overlap case, finite-state observed-Hessian score+readout target >=3x faster than the general observed-Hessian backend, comparing the SAME Cascade34 kernel, observation geometry, criterion and admitted approximation budget. Report sparse-case crossover; do not replace a family or relax accuracy to win.
- Absolute engineering target: B0 complete two-reference Cascade34 profile+readout+certification <=120 seconds on the declared CPU-only JVM baseline (up to 8 workers, >=32 GiB host RAM), excluding input acquisition and disk persistence; report preparation and complete IO-inclusive elapsed time separately. Record exact CPU, OS, JDK, heap, compiler/provider revisions and power/thread settings. Freeze the actual reference host in PHRF-01 before measurement. This is a proposed target, not a hardware-independent promise.
- JVM and Scala.js both run correctness and relative scaling courts; JS uses one worker and at least V=10,000, with its absolute throughput reported separately. Timing: no build/startup in steady-state compute; warm up until stable, record >=5 measured runs, median/p95, allocations/GC, preparation and IO. Cold preparation is separately reported.
- Accuracy co-gate: benchmark the complete attempted cohort, not accepted cases selected afterwards. On the preregistered local well-identified cohort target >=95% admitted, with p95 decoded-vs-nonlinear-oracle peak latency <=0.02 s and FWHM <=0.05 s, p95 relative trial amplitude L2 error <=0.1%; enforce declared original-system residual/score budgets. Undefined summaries and deliberate ambiguity cases are assessed separately, never silently removed. These are approximation-agreement targets, not claims of real-fMRI precision.
- An unmet target stays visible as failed/unmet. Revise targets only through an explicit evidence-backed decision recording old/new values and tradeoff; do not close performance qualification on asymptotic arguments or a smoke run.

Specification: docs/plans/profile-hrf.md (SHA256 d0d3d44b533dd5d01022968a2dba20bb5807252026e1fb1ebdf4b69677148168). Work-item index: docs/plans/profile-hrf-work-items.md. Shared unification probe: tools/validation/profile_hrf_unification.py (SHA256 55ca9b653e911430d8d8268248e61dac1e8be2ec3ada507f71fd1d9a124d2e28); receipt: docs/plans/profile_hrf_unification_checks.json. Existing research probes remain docs/plans/profile_hrf_context_checks.py and tools/validation/profile_hrf_review.py. Supplied condition/trial/innovation/alignment artifacts were inspected and rerun; exact source hashes and limitations are in the specification. These are planning/research artifacts, not production Scala implementation, broad calibration or throughput evidence.
